1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising:
- obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network using a processor;
- assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using the processor;
- assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor;
- determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the processor; and
- generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present using the processor, wherein the traffic message is generated by transforming the traffic data and advertising reference code into a formatted message structure for transmission to navigation systems.

- generating a message having an advertising reference code using a processor, wherein the message is generated by transforming the advertising reference code into a formatted message structure; and

- generating a message having advertisements using a processor, wherein the message is generated by transforming advertisement data into a formatted message structure; and

29. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements using location reference codes comprising:
- receiving a message from a traffic supplier using a processor, wherein the message contains a location reference and an advertising reference code;
- assessing at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code using the processor;
- transforming the at least one advertisement into displayable content; and
- presenting the at least one advertisement to a user of the navigation system at a location based on the location reference code, wherein the displayable content is output on a display device coupled to the navigation system.

- a memory having a message with a location reference code and an advertising reference code;
- a processor coupled to the memory, wherein the processor assesses at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code and transforms the at least one advertisement into displayable content;
